cohort: 100 patients who underwent abdominal surgery with suspected abdominal wall endometriosis or abdominal wall tumor at the General Surgery Service of Hospital Universitario Antonio Pedro (HUAP) at Universidade Federal Fluminense (UFF) between January 2000 and December 2019
finding: The study found an association between previous cesarean section and abdominal wall endometriosis, with the majority of women diagnosed with abdominal wall endometriosis having undergone previous cesarean sections.
